items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Ethel Waters sang better than anybody ever sang it. And then Ethel Waters left to do that show... She copied as good as she could from Ethel Waters.

ctx.x: Ethel Waters. And Ethel Waters sang better than anybody ever sang it. And then Ethel Waters left to do that show, and Lena made the picture. And Lena didn't sing
